# Kenneth Louie Cleofe (Ken Cleofe)

AI Automation & Operations Specialist based in Marikina City, Philippines.

## What I do
I build systems that eliminate manual, repetitive operational work by connecting business apps, automating CRM workflows, deploying AI agents, and building custom applications when off-the-shelf tools aren't enough.

## Who I help
Small and medium businesses in Australia, the United States and the United Kingdom that want to remove manual, repetitive work. I bring 8+ years of hands-on operations experience, so I fix the process first, then automate it.

## How to work with me
Projects start with a free 30 to 60 minute discovery call. Pricing depends on the workload: after scoping, clients get a fixed quote before anything is built.

## Services
- Workflow Automation Builds (Zapier, Make, n8n)
- CRM Automation & Integration (GoHighLevel, HubSpot)
- AI Tool Implementation (ChatGPT, Claude, prompt engineering)
- Ops Systems & SOPs (documentation, handover, training)
- Custom Web Apps, AI-Assisted (admin dashboards, client portals, CRM and API integrations, live deployment)

## Industries served
- Large-scale printing
- Wealth & wellness
- Real estate
- Retail and banking/financial services

## Notable projects
- Quoting App Rebuild: a full custom Django quoting application for a large-scale printing business, covering admin dashboard and client-facing quote approval; in live use for 5 to 7 new quotes a day and built to scale to hundreds; removed hours of double tagging across the CRM, reports and follow-ups, and duplicate proof reports
- Golf Club Competitor Price & Inventory Monitor: a Python (pydoll) web scraping system tracking used golf club pricing, sales and stock across Australian competitor retailers, with scheduled Google Sheets reports via n8n and a live dashboard; saves months of manual market research
- AI Voice Receptionist & Booking System (n8n + Vapi)
- RAG Knowledge Agent with Live Sync (n8n)
- AI Agent for Facebook Messenger (n8n)

## Background
Currently System and Automation Manager at Site Skins, Focus Banners and Arena Branding, three sister brands under one owner (Australia, remote). Former Operations Manager (Summit Glazing Solutions) and Department Manager (SM Retail), with a background in banking/financial services before transitioning into automation and AI tooling.
